label: Делать
description: Scaffold verb card for first-conjugation typing practice. Expand each person into five sentences for the full 30-line deck.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person singular. 1. 'Делаю' is the standard present form. 2. 'Работу' keeps the sentence concrete. 3. This is the core template for the verb family.
Strategic focus: Second-person singular. 1. 'Делаешь' shows the -ешь ending. 2. 'Задачу' is a simple direct object. 3. This sentence starts the same-person conjugation ladder.
Strategic focus: Third-person singular. 1. 'Делает' is the standard first-conjugation third-person form. 2. 'Дело' keeps the grammar clear. 3. The line is short and easy to repeat.
Strategic focus: First-person plural. 1. 'Делаем' reinforces the plural ending. 2. 'План' is a practical noun for real-life use. 3. This is the natural 'we' form for the family.
Strategic focus: Polite/plural form. 1. 'Делаете' trains the respectful or plural address. 2. 'Выбор' makes the sentence abstract enough to matter. 3. This is a very reusable communication pattern.
Strategic focus: Third-person plural. 1. 'Делают' closes the basic conjugation set. 2. 'Шаг' gives a simple physical object/action anchor. 3. This completes the six-person scaffold for the verb.
